highlights.summary:
Indian School of Hospitality is a private college located in Gurugram, Haryana. ISH is a part of Sommet Education and has tie up with two brands which are École Ducasse and Les Roches. Moreover, the culinary programmes are offered in partnership with École Ducasse, Paris and hospitality programmes are taught in alliance with heLes Rocs, Switzerland.

Indian School of Hospitality offers undergraduate and postgraduate programmes and the courses include BA, BBA, International Culinary Programmes, Experiential Programmes and Intensive Culinary Arts Programme Certification.

The top recruiters of Indian School of Hospitality are The Oberoi Group, Marriot International, Accor Group, The Leela Yum, OYO, Interglobe. Also, ISH offers scholarships to their students which are both merit-based and need-based.

Indian School of Hospitality is a part of global Sommet Education network, along with some of the world’s best hospitality and culinary schools in South Africa, Switzerland, China, and France. Below is the list for Indian School of Hospitality alliances & partnerships:

Indian School of Hospitality provides undergraduate and postgraduate programmes and the courses include BA, BBA, International Culinary Programmes, Experiential Programmes and Intensive Culinary Arts Programme Certification.

Note: Total fee is calculated on the basis of Annual Fee available on the official website and doesn't include Residence Cost. The fee is for the year 2020 and is subject to vary. For more details visit the official website.

For Indian School of Hospitality admission, students have to be eligible to apply. The overall application process is done through online mode. If the candidate fulfils the eligibility criteria, then admission is done on the basis of merit.

Below is the detailed information regarding the Indian School of Hospitality eligibility criteria for each course:

Indian School of Hospitality provides different types of scholarships which are both merit-based and need-based. Below are the details regarding Indian School of Hospitality Scholarships:

Early entrance applicants:

The candidates who apply for admission before March 31 of each year are eligible for the scholarship.

All female candidates can apply for this type of scholarship. Those female candidates whose past, current and potential academic performance, including promising leadership qualities will get the scholarship.

International applicants:

All the international students get a 10% tuition fee waiver for the first year that is credited in two equal instalments and applied to first and second semester.

NGO/PSU/Armed Forces background award:

Indian School of Hospitality offers 10% off from tuition fees, for each year of their studies to the students of those who are actively involved in NGOs, public sector undertakings and the Armed Forces.

Students are assessed on their financial standing and need. Those who have a good record of academic or extra-curricular excellence are also considered.

review_summary.college_name: Rajiv Gandhi Degree College, Andhra Pradesh Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Maths, Physics, Computer Science) - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: We have enjoyed a lot during our tenure with friends and good events.

content.Placements: About 25% of the students from our course got placed. The highest salary offered is Rs. 25,000 per month and the lowest salary offered is Rs. 12,000 per month. The average salary offered is Rs. 16,000 per month. Top recruiters for our course are Infosys, Tech Mahindra, Wipro, etc. Top roles offered in our course are BPOs and others. The highest salary package offered in our course is 3 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 1.5 LPA. We got internships in some local companies.
content.Infrastructure: There is good infrastructure in our college, along with sports facilities and NCC. Our college has good computer labs, chemistry labs and a library. Our college provides Wi-Fi facility throughout the campus, along with internet facility. There is a ground for games, and sports faculty members provide good games kits for students. There is a gym for physical education. There is a library with a huge number of books.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (IRPM, Social Work, Psychology) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied a lot with the college staff and faculty. Very good placements. I love my college.

content.Placements: Present, I'm studying 1st year. Our seniors have got many placements. Good companies are hiring the students. The companies like Tata, Wipro, ITC, AMC, etc., came to the campus. A good designation is given to the students. The highest salary package I heard was 4.5 lakhs per annum, and the lowest package was 2.8 lakhs per annum.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has big computer rooms. We have a good library and big playground. Our college has NCC, so we learn everything in sports. Good medical facilities are also available. We have a pharmacy in our college. We have good internet connection from the college side. The classrooms are too good. The satisfied hostel facilities are also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Maths, Electronics, Computer Science) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Our college has good infrastructure, poor faculty members and a large computer lab.

content.Placements: Only 5% of the students got placed in our course. There was less chance to get selected. The highest salary offered was Rs. 12,000 before training. Top companies like Wipro and Infosis offer jobs. These are good companies to work. Top roles were offered in our course, and students get the best experience. The salary offered was Rs. 15,000 per annum only. There were good chances for internships. Almost 60% of the students got internships from our college.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities provided in our college were good. We have a Jio Wi-Fi connectivity on campus, and we can access free Wi-Fi any time. All the course-related labs like a science lab and computer lab are very large. It has one of the largest computer lab college. Classrooms were good with good ventilation, lighting, air and light, and fan facilities. A library was available for students, and it had a good collection of books.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Good placement in 2018, really good facilities.

content.Placements: The placements in our college called Gandhi degree college is very important and useful to the student. The best companies have been recruiting the employees from our college only. Big companies offer high salaries and remuneration. Good future in these companies.
content.Infrastructure: Free speed Wi-Fi. Friendly hotels Home food Library place is very silent. No one disturbs in the library. Sports very important in our college, therefore, the campus has a big ground. Labs in this college in very well. Hostel rooms and food is like that of home.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. - Chemistry, Bio-Chemistry, Micro Biology - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: A fine college for a fine student. Not too much expectations.

content.Placements: Good placements with 90% and with good packages and perks. Internships are not provided but you can individually apply for a lot of companies and can gain experience. It is an integral part of college. I give an 8/10 rating for our college placements. Government jobs are also offered.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is the one thing which one can see at the first sight of the college. So as of now our college provides an average infrastructure and it's old a bit but still, it has a great service. Students are taken care of well. Hostels are provided with good facilities.

individual_reviews.title: The faculty is good, but students are not taken seriously.

content.Placements: I don't know much about the placements. But the B.Com course can give you an average starting salary of Rs. 20,000 for bachelor of commerce and bachelor of computer application.
content.Infrastructure: In essence, ASP College offers a well-rounded, contemporary campus infrastructure that fosters academic excellence, practical learning, physical well-being, and student welfare. All supported by advanced technology and a green ambience. The campus is good.
content.Faculty: Examinations are conducted in a semester pattern and are considered moderately challenging. The evaluation process is transparent, with a good balance of objective, descriptive, and application-based questions. Internal assessment, presentations, and assignments also contribute to the final grades, promoting continuous learning. Overall, the B.Com. program at ASP College is academically rigorous and professionally relevant. The teaching approach is student-friendly, and the college ensures students are prepared not just for exams but for future careers. This combination of dedicated faculty, industry-oriented curriculum, and structured assessment makes it a preferred choice for commerce aspirants in North Karnataka. Teachers are supportive.

individual_reviews.title: My BBA college life is the best.

content.Placements: Placement is much needed for our career. Here, 75% of students get placement after completing the BBA degree. I want to work in Tata Steel company. Our college mainly focuses on student management skills. They always motivate us to do any function or activity on campus.

It has a separate department for each section. The classrooms are very clean, and they also have projectors.

individual_reviews.title: Absolutely good college, teachers and all the facilities are provided.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: A journey that changed my life.

content.Placements: Placement drive of IGC has been one of the best out there. They guided us through every detail of the interviews and what the company was looking for in their candidates. With constant placement activity in college along with my classmates, we had landed handsome jobs with remarkable companies.
content.Infrastructure: IGC had one of the best infrastructure and surroundings, with clean classrooms and hostel, with 24-hour medical facility. Coming from a different state, I always feel paranoid about my living away from home. But IGC was more like home away from home. I never had such difficulty adjusting to its environment.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: This college is absolutely very amazing, especially in rainy season and also it's interesting.

content.Placements: Recently, I completed my bachelor in business administration. This is all about how business works and how we can start our own business with perfect planning and decision. There are many types of companies that come to our college and select many students in different fields.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my college (IGGOC) is very calm and beautiful. It is perfect for study and fresh mind. There is greenery everywhere. Every department has a different building. The environment is very beautiful most of the time. In the rainy season, we can see the real beauty of this college.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Everything is good, faculty is awesome, academics are good too, but placements disappoint me a lot.

content.Placements: The placement of our college is not that good. Sure, companies visit here, but the salary is not that good. It's not even the bare minimum. One of my seniors, who was in the last year, got an internship at a Haryana travel agency, which was a semi-government agency. The pay was around Rs.5,000, but the working hours were less, and it was a good opportunity for experience in the work field. However, the placement needs to become a little better here.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very nice. It's really beautiful and soothing, to be honest, it's so close to nature. We can see the mountains from our college. The college building and campus are full of greenery and are clean 24/7. But, if we talk about hostel food, it does not serve good. Our breakfast and lunch are still bearable, but dinner time is horrible for all the hostelers. There are games and events from time to time. Every year, sports week is conducted by the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: This college is best for students who want to take admission in architecture. All the best.

content.Placements: There are 87 students placed in my course at Indo Global College of Engineering. The highest package of our college goes to 18 LPA but this is off-campus, not on campus. There are so many companies who visit our college for their recruitment like Pisoft and others.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very impressive and gives us good vibes. All department facilities are okay. Hostel facilities are also good. A maximum students got internships from my course. Most students got internships in very good companies. I don't know the names of those companies.

review_summary.college_name: Spicer Adventist University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The worst hostel, old college with decent legacy.

content.Placements: There's no placement. No internship, just provided with a degree. There is only hope in the Adventist mission that you might get a job; otherwise, students seek outside jobs, such as in malls and shops. Students are exposed only to theoretical knowledge and not to practical knowledge.
content.Infrastructure: There is a bad quality food in the cafeteria, unhygienic washrooms in the hostel, broken beds, and difficult to deal with roommates in the hostel. No proper facilities are provided. College infrastructure is good, a lush green campus, and Wi-Fi is good. Medical facilities are not provided. Fees are too high.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I like the campus and faculty members are friendly.

content.Placements: In my course, there are around 60 students. I don't know other details because we just got the result now. Tata is one of the companies which recruit students from our university. The top role offered in our university might be HR.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms and the university are very clean. It has a good, and natural environment with a number of trees. Each tree has a number return on it.
content.Faculty: Faculty members are friendly and some are not because they are strict with their professions. Some teachers are highly qualified. New teachers are not highly qualified. The pass percentage is 40%. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students industry-ready.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in Economics - Batch of 2014
individual_reviews.title: Adventist satisfaction because of the environment.

content.Placements: The placements are there for the one who completes the masters in the various parts of Adventist communities, and even for the bachelors, there is placement. The placements are good except the salary they provide. They provide mostly teaching facilities and faculty as a secretary.
content.Infrastructure: There are labs, sports, classrooms, canteens all are available in the college. It's a beautiful college, and many functions are held in it like camping, sports day, BYLC, MMAC, SEED day, freshers night, talent night and many more. Almost all Sunday there is programme held at the college, which makes you fresh for the next week.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: My classic university from with I am satisfied and I love this.

content.Placements: The placements of our college is very good. As I know, last year from commerce block, forty students were recruited in different companies like ICICI, Sriram Ramgopal, HDFC etc. The highest package is 18 L/year which is offered by Sriram Ramgopal company to our genius senior Sachin Gopal. The minimum package of salary was 15 lakh/year. There were three phases which were conducted. In the first phase, companies introduced the students to their work and needs with the help of PowerPoint. Then interested students chose their companies according to their choice. After that, written test was organised. Then F2F interview by the companies of the students passed in written test. In the last phase, selected students was called to the stage for honour. Internship is very important for experience, personality improvement and skills. Our college gets highest internship in and area of Pune because of discipline, good behaviour and multitalented students. I can say that here eighty percent students got internship and stipend offers around two-three lakhs per year.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: The college has good facilities and infrastructure.

content.Placements: Around 30 percent of students were placed, with an average package of 3 LPA. Companies included Wipro, HAL, TDS, Infosys, and schools/colleges. About 50 percent of students got internships in various companies as mentioned above, in roles such as teaching, professors, HR management, and bank management. Most students, however, were seeking higher-level opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library were average. Hostel facilities, mess and canteen, medical facilities, sports, and games were average. The food quality remained the same for decades, and the menu did not change. The hostel was the biggest problem as it was unclean, unhygienic, and not maintained properly.

admission_overview.description: Spicer Adventist University (SAU) admission is both merit-based and entrance-based. The admission process starts in June every year. Admission to all the programmes is based on candidates’ performance in the PERA CET examination. Out of the total approved intake of the programme, 70% of the seats shall be reserved for the students, having permanent residency in Maharashtra. Spicer Adventist University offers UG courses, such as BA, BA (Hons), BBA, BCom, BPA, BSc and BSc (Hons), whereas MA, MBA, MSc and B.Ed are offered at the postgrauate level.

reviews.review_heading: The worst hostel, old college with decent legacy.
reviews.review_text: There is a bad quality food in the cafeteria, unhygienic washrooms in the hostel, broken beds, and difficult to deal with roommates in the hostel. No proper facilities are provided. College infrastructure is good, a lush green campus, and Wi-Fi is good. Medical facilities are not provided. Fees are too high.

reviews.review_heading: I like the campus and faculty members are friendly.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and the university are very clean. It has a good, and natural environment with a number of trees. Each tree has a number return on it.

reviews.review_heading: Adventist satisfaction because of the environment.
reviews.review_text: There are labs, sports, classrooms, canteens all are available in the college. It's a beautiful college, and many functions are held in it like camping, sports day, BYLC, MMAC, SEED day, freshers night, talent night and many more. Almost all Sunday there is programme held at the college, which makes you fresh for the next week.

reviews.review_heading: My classic university from with I am satisfied and I love this.
reviews.review_text: Spicer has all common facilities that should be there in every good college like separate hostels for both boys and girls. Labs, a big sports ground with multiples games facilities, wifi, medical, music facilities, and the best facility is spiritual refreshment which I like. This college is best for those who like some discipline and moral teachings. The social environment is best here.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good facilities and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library were average. Hostel facilities, mess and canteen, medical facilities, sports, and games were average. The food quality remained the same for decades, and the menu did not change. The hostel was the biggest problem as it was unclean, unhygienic, and not maintained properly.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is amazing. Staff members and students are welcoming and very hospitable.
reviews.review_text: Our college is 100 years old, which makes it unique. Healthy, hygienic and good food is available in the mess and canteen. Women and men's have separate hostel buildings on the campus. There are a gym and sports facilities, along with a dispensary on the campus. Our college also has psychiatrists for students.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with outrageous staff.
reviews.review_text: The campus is lush green with 70 acres of land. Classrooms are neat; however, the hostel lacks basic amenities like cold water, clean corridors, and the staff are not helpful. The library is filled with outdated books. Wi-Fi works just fine. The canteen is average.

reviews.review_heading: Good facilities and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available on our college campus. The labs are very modern, with digital classrooms and a library for studying. The facilities are very polite towards students, and the mess food is very good and delicious. The canteen is also available. A cricket ground and a football ground are available in the college, and many other games are played. Medical facilities are also available on the college campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jahangirabad Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Students got a very good Wi-Fi experience. The food in the canteen was good and had a good taste. They keep all things fresh.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with the college and faculty's behavior. Poor education, poor facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very poor because our college has dimmed low light classrooms, outdated books in the library, a slow-speed Wi-Fi connection, and many more. Hostel facilities are average. The canteen is available in the college but it is always set to close every time, no sports and game equipment provided to the students. They have to manage their own.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good and very affordable college.
reviews.review_text: There is 24 hours availability of light, and a washing machine is also available on our campus. Wi-Fi is available on our campus. Classrooms are good and unique, and there are also smart classrooms. The library is good, and there are different libraries for different branches. There is 24 hours availability of canteen and ambulance service.

reviews.review_heading: I consider our college better because it provides the best quality education at an affordable price.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very beautiful because earlier it was a fort. The college library is also quite good, and every book is present here related to relevant courses. Classrooms and labs are very huge and clean. Everything is accessible in labs. Free service of Wi-Fi is available. When we talk about hostels, this college provides great facilities for hostels because it includes a separate bathroom, enough space for rooms, and 24X7 electricity. Mess food is average, and canteen ma...

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college as compared to the fee.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available here are like a good amount of books available in the hostel in a separate hostel library. Wi-Fi speed is normal. Classrooms and library are well-maintained. Food quality is average, but the canteen is good. Sports held here are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jahangirabad Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not excellent, but it is good enough as compared with the fee. Wi-Fi and labs are functional, and hostel rooms are maintained. Canteen is also good in terms of cleanliness and pricing of things. Sports courts are also available if you are sporty.

reviews.review_heading: Hostel facilities are good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good, and there are Wi-Fi, labs and a library. Classrooms seats are not much comfortable. I would give 5 stars for hostel facilities as they are very good. Rooms are huge and clean with a separate bathroom for each room. Canteen and mess facilities are average as most of the colleges have. There is a doctor for students for good medical health. Our college also has various aspects of games.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied because of faculty members, poor education and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have low lighting, and the labs are not updated with the latest equipment. There are outdated books in the library. The security in the hostel is not good. Many things got stolen from our room when I was at home. The food served is also not good, and there are no many sports.

reviews.review_heading: The college has very good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: JIT has a very good infrastructure, high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, classrooms, smart classrooms and a library with a lot of interesting and knowledgeable books. Our college provides good medical facilities to its students. JIT has its own medical clinic within the college.

reviews.review_heading: If you're looking for a college of less fee structure, then this college is for you.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is the main attraction of our college. The old buildings, the lush green campus provide a view of a farmhouse. Our college consists of 2 academic buildings, three hostel blocks, separate football field and cricket field, etc. Our college building was revamped from the fort of Raja Jahangirabad. There is a mosque in the campus from the 80s. The hostel is Wi-Fi-enabled. The library contains volumes that cover most of the engineering, MBA and media courses. A good canteen is what...

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Since it was a fort, the infrastructure is pretty good, some of the buildings are new, and some are 100 years old. If I talk about environment and atmosphere, it is really very good like there is no pollution and it is green everywhere, which everybody likes. We also have also a washing machine and dryer in the hostel and at each block.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the environment of the college but a little improvement in the field of management.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of our college is fantastic for studying. Campus is full of greeneries away from the disturbing life of the city with clean and fresh air. Exceptionally calm and friendly environment hostel facility is very comfortable. Academics and curriculum are given the highest preference.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure, Dissatisfied with management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of jahagirabad institute of technology is awesome. You I talk about best things of college infrastructure should be on top of the list. It has a Beautiful Masque. In the center of Hostel. It is a FORT of king and it spread 500 akar. It maintain every year.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it's an average college. It is s good college for sincere and self-motivated students.
reviews.review_text:
The infrastructure is good with a clean and green environment. Although located on outskirts of Barabanki city, College has good facilities like internet, food, electricity etc.
The reading room and the library are well-equipped with a lot of books with general and course books as well.

content.Placements: For design, there’s almost no placement. No student has yet completed the course as it started three years ago, but still, looking at other factors, you will have to find internships yourself. The percentage of internships in 3rd year is 4 percent till now.
content.Infrastructure: Pretty campus, AC's in almost all classes except the old classrooms. For hostels, there are many restrictions. For girls, no one is allowed outside after 9, for boys, it’s a bit lenient. Clean rooms with windows. Boys’ hostel lacks a laundry though. A few small adjustments will have to be made.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The college beats many top-tier colleges in terms of placement, and the overall experience is great.

content.Placements: Approximately 70% to 74% of students have been placed so far. The highest package for the EE branch this year is 52 LPA. The average package remains 12.90 LPA and the lowest package offered was 3.20 LPA. Microsoft, Google, Apple, BMW, Maruti, L&T, and Siemens are some of the top recruiters.
content.Infrastructure: Personally, I feel the infrastructure is quite updated and should be replaced, and development is ongoing. Everything a student needs is present on the campus. I like the library, computer labs, and reading area. The classrooms are equipped with smart projectors, and Wi-Fi is available throughout the building. The hostels are quite decent; again, the infrastructure is quite outdated, and the mess food is also decent. Sports facilities are available for every kind of game, like volleyball, cricket, basketball, and there is also a swimming pool inside the campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Truth about the infrastructure of PEC, Chandigarh.

content.Placements: Almost 75% of students were placed in our course. On average, the highest and the lowest packages were around 8.5, 26, and 5 LPA, respectively. Top recruiting companies included Tata Projects, L&T, and government bodies as well. Top roles offered were structural engineer, design engineer, site supervisor, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Classes lack Wi-Fi and internet connectivity due to jammers installed in the classes. The library is well-equipped with all the necessary facilities and Wi-Fi connectivity. The infrastructure of classes and labs is a bit too old. The facilities of the hostel are also just enough to survive, and the food quality is average. The canteen food is good. The college has enough facilities for endorsing sports and games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Materials and Metallurgical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: My college review, the one and only Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh.

content.Placements: College is good with lots of great opportunities. I am currently in my first year in the metallurgy branch. I will be passing out in 2029. The top recruiting companies are Google, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, etc. The highest package is 77 LPA, and the lowest is 3.5 LPA. While the average is 13 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are not good, with decent infrastructure and a lack of facilities. Although the college is reputable, the infrastructure is not up to the mark, and Wi-Fi is also good. The library is decent, considering IITs, it is very below average, labs are good, and there are many labs.

paragraphs: PEC Chandigarh admissions are entrance-based.The college offers UG, PG, and PhD courses in Engineering. The college accepts JEE Mains, GATE for selection and also conducts counselling for seat allocation. The process can be completed online. admission_process.title: Sai University Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: Sai University admission processhas application, appearance in the selection rounds, offline admission process, and submission of a Personal Statement steps. Below are the details of the same:-

For online application, candidates need to submit the basic registration details. Candidates can fill out the Sai University application form 2025 from the official website by paying anapplication fee of INR 500.

After completing the application, candidates need to appear for the university-level entrance exam. Candidates who have appeared for the national or state-level entrance exam for the respective course are exempted from theSai University CAT.

This round is conducted to understand the candidate's aspirations and evaluation based on a Personal Statement submitted by the candidate. This round will be done through a Zoom call. Also, various factors provided in the application are evaluated in this round. After this, the admission panel finalizes the candidate's admission based on their score in the entrance exams & performance in the qualifying exams.

Sai University's selection process includes examining candidates based on their aspirations and experiences. The admission panel will also evaluate the candidates based on their academic and extracurricular accomplishments during the selection process for admission and scholarship eligibility.
Candidates shortlisted will receive an admission confirmation. After that, they will have to submit the prescribed registration fee for the respective course.

Sai University is launchingSAIUCAT(Sai University Common Admission Test), an online entrance exam for our undergraduate and postgraduate admissions. The test lasts for 60 minutes (with AI proctoring) and evaluates students on the following topics:

A detailed syllabus and sample Q&A are soon to be released. After submitting the application form, students will receive the test link via email or in the student dashboard. Candidates who have already taken SAT/ACT exams or other national and state-level entrance tests may choose to opt out of the SAIU CAT.Note:While taking these tests is optional, submitting these scores will present the complete profile of the student.

faqs.question: What is the fee for MBA course at Sai University?
faqs.answer: The tuition fee for the MBA courses given at Sai University, for every specialisation, is Rs. 6 lakh. This fee can be paid in 2 instalments during the course. Once, at the time of enrolment, and secondly, after completing the 1st-year of the course, that refers to the two semesters.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty but currently do not know about placements.
reviews.review_text: Food is good, and the hostel is good with no issues. NCC is available, and the food facility is great. The campus is small but sufficient for the strength present here. Medical facilities are good with no problems in the hostel or campus. There are library and gym facilities. Wi-Fi is available 24 hours.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with global approach for studies.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available on campus. All the labs are available like Biology IT, etc. It has a library that is under construction. I stay in a 3 BHK villa near a beach. There are very good cafes nearby. Sports facilities are available at the villa with a common dining space and me-time zone.
